chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Why MCA never signed them and the Plantation mistake
summary: Meyer Davis was as big as MCA; taking the Plantation was the band's biggest mistake, before the fire.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: It seems funny that somebody like MCA wouldn't try to sign the band.
I don't know why they didn't, but Meyer Davis was just about as big as them.
At that time Meyer Davis was--

That was a mistake of the band. That was the biggest mistake they made, not only from the standpoint, which we couldn't foretell what was going to happen about the fire, but I mean that was a big job too--
The Plantation was a pretty well known place.
Yes; it was a fine job.
Remember that time you came up to see me at Columbia, the early sixties, 1961, '62--
(Side B of Tape 1 ended at this point.
